search.snippet: Cadavaberry seeds are seeds which can be planted and grown into cadava berries at level 22 Farming. They must be planted in bush patches. A nearby gardener will watch over your growing cadavaberry bush for a payment of 3 baskets of tomatoes. They can be used to grow the cadava berries needed to provide a payment of 6 cadava berries to Ayesha to have her watch over the cactus patch in Al-Kharid.
